handoff.suggestion: Consider splitting core.py into separate modules for queue management, governance, and provider health to reduce god-object complexity. Verify that _gov_discrimination and _gov_write_confinement are actually called somewhere (e.g., from a dashboard endpoint); if not, they may be dead code. The _probe_local_only_fail_closed function mutates a global via globals() which can cause reentrancy issues in long-lived processes – consider a safer stub mechanism.
